issue_context.title: Private fields should not be accessible outside the class
comments:
> This PR seems to be breaking private properties generally:
> 
> ```js
> export class Pool {
>   #x;
>   constructor (x: number) {
>     this.#x = x;
>   }
> }
> ```
> 
> ```
>   x Illegal access to private class property.
>     ,-[src/common/pool.ts:22:5]
>  22 | this.#x = x;
>     : ^^^^^^^
>     `----
> 
> Error: Failed to compile 1 file with swc.
>     at Object.assertCompilationResult (C:\Users\Guy\Projects\generator\node_modules\@swc\cli\lib\swc\util.js:113:15)
>     at files (C:\Users\Guy\Projects\generator\node_modules\@swc\cli\lib\swc\file.js:173:18)    
>     at async _default (C:\Users\Guy\Projects\generator\node_modules\@swc\cli\lib\swc\file.js:192:9)
> ```

This seems to be happening only with `typescript`. Equivalent JS transpiles correctly. Playground [link](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.175&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0utKMgvKlFIzkksLlYIyM%2FPUajmUlBQrrAGksn5ecUlRaXJJflFChoVmmAZBYWSjMxiPeUKBVsFsKJarloAdPOgIUQAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAAxXIwQmAQAxE0V7m7NVLerCIEIIoqEsmC8qyvUtu%2F%2F2BkwYZaBr0qOJ3p74QuF1Ki6Ml5oLU2D1rcy3z6WG%2BaSMko%2Fv8AWfE%2FlpLAAAA).
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.
